metadata.description: Per-environment flash and RAM build-size budgets for protoArtoo firmware
notes: Flash: binary image size (.bin file) to fit in the OTA partition
RAM: static allocation (.data + .bss sections), not heap or PSRAM
Budgets set with deliberate headroom to prevent reflexive raises on legitimate commits
P4 environments (firebeetle2*) from Makefile P4_ENVS; artoo_esp32 is classic platform
Baseline measurements are recorded with the commit SHA for traceability

artoo_esp32.budget_rationale: Measured 1.57MB flash (92.1% of partition), 96.3KB RAM (77.3% of DRAM limit). Flash budget set at 1.6MB (94% of partition, 2.7% headroom) to allow growth without silent erosion. RAM budget at 110KB (88% of limit) leaves safety margin for stack growth.

firebeetle2.budget_rationale: First-flash bringup env with minimal source filter (src/ excluded). Baseline from #190 Slice 2 coordinator verification. Budgets set well above measured values to accommodate full firmware adaptation (tracked by #188/#189).

firebeetle2_hosted_bench.budget_rationale: ESP-Hosted WiFi over SDIO proof-of-concept. Budget accommodates protocol stack overhead. Will be refined after #188 stabilizes.

firebeetle2_full.budget_rationale: Diagnostic build for #190: compiles all of src/ against P4 toolchain to report compatibility issues. Budget set 400KB above measured value to allow full image growth during platform development.
